en: This is a sepia-toned image of a tranquil natural landscape featuring a reflective pond surrounded by lush trees, including willows and evergreens. Lily pads are visible on the pond, and there is a distant view of hills or low mountains in the background. The image is peaceful and idyllic, with no urban development or prominent man-made landmarks visible. There is no visible text on the front of the postcard.
